priceSnapshot.note: Recovered from a fresh session low (82,606.2) that swept through the 82,650 long-liquidation magnet; a confirmed 1H close at 82,679 broke below the 82,874.5 support/reduceIf level before reclaiming it the next hour. Now consolidating around 83,050-83,080, still below midnight's close (83,137.3) and well below the 83,818/84,125 resistance band broken two sessions ago.

reduceIf.confirmation: A confirmed 15m/1H close back below today's low (82,606.2) and the 82,650 liquidation magnet would signal the reclaim failed and reopens 82,500 then the 80,588 daily swing low.

addIf.confirmation: A confirmed 1H/4H close back above 83,818 (broken two sessions ago, still resistance) would mark the flush as fully reclaimed and open 84,125.

decisionBox.changed: A confirmed 1H close at 82,679 briefly broke the 82,874.5 reduceIf level before reclaiming it within the hour -- reading this as a swept low / failed breakdown rather than a fresh sell signal, so no reduce action taken. Redrew reduceIf to today's actual low (82,606.2), the level that would need to break to confirm renewed weakness; addIf/invalidatesAt are unchanged. The paper wallet added a small (15 USDT) spot-core DCA tranche into the reclaim at a lower entry than midnight's -- see Paper wallet section.

liquidityMagnet.source: OKX public liquidation-orders API (instType=SWAP, uly=BTC-USDT, state=filled, last 100 fills; sz in contracts, ctVal=0.01 BTC/contract) plus open-interest, funding-rate and long-short-account-ratio, fetched fresh via in-page fetch() from the okx.com origin using Claude in Chrome. Newest fill ~18min old, oldest ~4h old as of this check -- fresh.
liquidityMagnet.note: Long liquidations dominated ~19:1 this run ($620.4k vs $32.3k) as price swept the fresh low. 1H long/short account ratio is 1.43 (>1, longs even more crowded than midnight's 1.35) and funding flipped slightly positive (+0.00716%, longs paying), so downside vulnerability is still not cleared -- a re-break of 82,874.5/82,606.2 could trigger another leg of long liquidations toward 82,500.
